set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 1.

Problem:
SlurmLocalConfig.default (local/SlurmLocal.scala:36) sets CommandPolicy.captureLimit to ByteLimit.defaultEvidence (64 KiB), and SlurmLocal.default (:56) then feeds that value to LocalCommandSettings.maximumCaptureBytes. Fs2CommandExecutor.run (:92) takes min(64 KiB, 64 KiB), so stdout is truncated at 64 KiB before any parser sees it. AgentMain.scala:119 sets maximumCommandBytes to the same 64 KiB. The real captured squeue fixture (fixtures/slurm-25.05.6-v0.0.43-actual/stdout.json) is 8698 bytes for ONE two-element pending array, so structured observation fails with ParseFailed at roughly 7 concurrently observed jobs.

Root cause:
ByteLimit.defaultEvidence is a retention bound (how much output to keep as evidence) and is being used as a capture bound (how much output the parser may see). These are different concerns sharing one field.

Acceptance:
- CommandPolicy carries distinct capture and evidence-retention bounds, or the assemblies stop conflating them.
- Local and agent defaults capture at maximumCommandCapture and retain evidence at defaultEvidence.
- A regression test observes enough jobs to exceed 64 KiB of squeue JSON and asserts a successful parse plus truncated evidence.
set.title: P6f.28: Separate command-capture bound from evidence-retention bound
